# Project Design Context — neamat-global-fe

Source of truth: `../docs/Neamat_Global_App_Plan.pdf` + `packages/ui/src/styles/globals.css`.

## Project

- **Product:** Neamat Global corporate site (neamatglobal.com) + NeamatCare admin (neamatcare.com)
- **Stack:** Next.js 16 · React 19 · Tailwind v4 · shadcn/ui (radix-nova, RTL) · Framer Motion 13 · next-intl · RTK · RHF + Zod · NextAuth 4
- **Color mode:** light-only; navy "chapters" give contrast
- **Density:** comfortable (marketing)

## Tokens

| Token | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| navy-deep | #06284A | header, dark sections, headings |
| navy | #0B4778 | accents, secondary |
| gold | #E3BC62 | primary CTAs, highlights, glows |
| body | #17344E | body text |
| muted-text | #64788B | secondary text |
| surface | #F5F8FB | light sections |
| derived | color-mix only | gold-light/deep, navy-bright/ink, on-navy |
| unit colours | NeoPure blue, PropertyOS purple, BooleanForce orange, NEAMAT CARE green | icon tiles / badges only |

Fonts: Inter · IBM Plex Sans Arabic · Noto Sans Bengali.

## Components

- **Primitives (shadcn):** button (brand variants), card, sheet, navigation-menu, dropdown-menu, field, input-group, dialog, sidebar, …
- **Brand:** Header, Footer, GoldPillButton, SectionEyebrow, BusinessCard, NewsCard, WorldMap, Reveal/Stagger/CountUp, CareLogo
- **App patterns:** SectionHeading, PageHero, CtaBand
- **Surfaces:** `bg-mesh-navy`, `bg-mesh-light`, `bg-grid-light/navy`, `bg-dots-gold`, `glass-dark`, `glass-light`, `text-gradient-gold/navy`

## Constraints

### Must
- Brand tokens only (theme lock + ESLint rule)
- shadcn first; RTL logical utilities; WCAG AA; ≥44px targets; reduced motion respected
- All copy via next-intl (en + ar)

### Avoid
- New hex colours, gold body text on white, layout-property animation, hand-rolled primitives

## Decisions

- **2026-09-30 — Vibrant direction:** alternating navy/light chapters, gradient meshes, glass cards, gold gradient text,
  scroll-reveal + counters + animated map route. Grounded in ui-ux-pro-max (Scroll-Triggered Storytelling, Liquid Glass)
  and 21st references (Glassmorphism Trust Hero, Milestone Timeline, World Map).
- **2026-09-30 — Pill eyebrows:** navy on gold tint on light backgrounds (gold-on-white fails AA).
